sloka: नाना आकाराणि वासांसि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः ।मुक्ता वैदूर्य चित्राणि भूषणानि तथैव च ।स्त्रीणाम् यानि अनुरूपाणि पुरुषाणाम् तथैव च ॥४-४३-४५॥
transliteration: nānā ākārāṇi vāsāṁsi phalanti anye nagottamāḥ ।muktā vaidūrya citrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tathaiva ca ।strīṇām yāni anurūpāṇi puruṣāṇām tathaiva ca ॥4-43-45॥

translations.english: 'There the trees are filled with flowers and fruits in all seasons. Birds rest on them. By their excellent fragrance, taste and smooth feel the fruits and flowers satisfy the desires of all. Some other excellent trees provide barks of various kinds which are used for cloth.
